title: Integrability of Conformal Killing Vectors in the Eisenhart Lift of Scalar-Field FLRW Cosmology
summary: We study the integrability conditions of the conformal Killing equations for the Eisenhart lift of a scalar field in a flat Friedmann-Lema\^ıtre-Robertson-Walker universe. The determinant condition of the prolonged conformal Killing equations reduces to a nonlinear second-order differential equation for $h=V'/V$. We solve this equation locally and find two branches.
